AutoOps Agent Demo streaming interaction attribution

OpenChamber
https://github.com/openchamber/openchamber
Commit: 6491f51dbcf05d1e3f7f823049f5f097c96c234b
Source: packages/ui/src/components/chat/hooks/useStreamingTextThrottle.ts
Adapted in: web/src/agent-demo/use-streaming-text.js
Changes: 32 ms render window, immediate first text/terminal flush, identity-safe replacements; no typing animation.
Sources: packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/scroll/followScroll.ts;
         packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/scroll/timelineScrollIntent.ts
Adapted in: web/src/agent-demo/vendor/openchamber/follow-scroll.js;
            web/src/agent-demo/vendor/openchamber/timeline-scroll-intent.js
Changes: React DOM scroll controller integration, reader intent and nested scrolling,
         per-conversation position restoration, reduced-motion support.

Additional reliability adaptations (2026-10-21, same OpenChamber commit and MIT license):
- packages/ui/src/hooks/useChatTimelineScroll.ts (gesture-driven opt-out)
  -> web/src/agent-demo/use-chat-scroll.js: real wheel/touch/key/scrollbar input
  releases follow; layout-only scroll movement does not imply reader intent.
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/scroll/messageViewportAnchor.ts
  (message identity plus viewport offset), lib/scroll/holdAnchor.ts and
  components/LiveActivityCollapse.tsx
  -> web/src/agent-demo/turn-activity.jsx: ActivityAnswerAnchor captures a part
  identity and position before React moves its DOM out of live activity, then
  reuses the existing ported holdAnchor. Local DOM lifecycle adapter, not a copy
  of OpenChamber's virtualized list API. Outside-viewport collapse uses geometry
  captured before the move.
- packages/web/server/lib/opencode/health-wait.js
  -> agent-demo/vendor/openchamber/health-wait.mjs: original bounded, cancellable
  health waiting helpers copied; AutoOps supplies its Bridge readiness probe.
  The server-side copy also includes agent-demo/vendor/openchamber/LICENSE.
- packages/ui/src/lib/opencode/client.ts (sendMessage / compactSession)
  -> agent-demo/runtime-sessions.mjs and codex-bridge.mjs: session ownership
  behavior adapted to Codex thread/start, thread/resume and turn/start. Original
  adapter code retains runtime identities and authorization fingerprints, not
  an OpenCode SDK copy or a second transcript/summary engine.
- packages/ui/src/sync/attachment-files.ts (input-modality capability checks)
  -> agent-demo/attachments.mjs and server/Bridge adapters: explicit extraction
  availability metadata; native PDF handling is adapted with Mozilla PDF.js.


Additional sources migrated 2026-10-21 (same OpenChamber commit and MIT license):
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/message/MessageBody.tsx (UserMessageBody,
  shouldShowTurnFooter, finalTurnActionButtons, footerSheetActions)
  -> message-actions.jsx/css, Chat.jsx: pointer hover/focus icon row, assistant
  branch menu, one labelled touch sheet, and terminal assistant footer gating.
  MobileOverlayPanel is replaced with the existing shadcn/Radix Sheet for local
  focus management and portals; unsupported OpenCode actions are omitted.
  AutoOps interrupted turns and empty-error retry controls use its own status API.
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/composer/ui/ComposerActionButtons.tsx
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/composer/keyboardPolicy.ts
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/QueuedMessagesStrip.tsx
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/FormDock.tsx
  -> conversation-controls.jsx; vendor/openchamber/keyboard-policy.js
  State branches, independent stop, preferred follow-up delivery, IME policy,
  queue folding and request-bound clarification adapted to shadcn and AutoOps APIs.
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/message/parts/ReasoningPart.tsx
  -> reasoning.jsx: summary cleanup, manual/automatic folding ownership, nested follow.
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/search/chatSearchHighlight.ts
  -> vendor/openchamber/search-highlight.js: CSS Highlight ranges, adapted to Chinese
  and fragmented incremental Markdown text nodes, without mutating parser-owned DOM.
- packages/ui/src/lib/exportSession.ts
  -> conversation-export.js: ordered Markdown, Unicode filename, browser Blob download.
- packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/turns/windowTurns.ts
  -> use-history-window.js: whole-turn indexing and initial render window.
- packages/ui/src/sync/session-actions.ts (forkAfterMessage / forkFromMessage),
  components/chat/ChatInput.tsx (takeForSend), hooks/useQueuedMessageAutoSend.ts
  -> agent-demo/server.mjs: behavior adapted to SQLite ownership, history boundaries,
  drafts and atomic queue dispatch. These are protocol rewrites, not SDK copies.

Source-based conversation parity migration (2026-10-21, same commit):
- components/chat/components/{LiveTurnActivity,LiveActivityCollapse,useActivityRowGlide}.tsx
- components/chat/lib/turns/{activityRows,liveActivity}.ts
- components/chat/lib/scroll/holdAnchor.ts
  -> turn-activity.jsx, turn-activity-model.js, vendor/openchamber/activity-rows.js,
     hold-anchor.js and use-activity-row-glide.js. AutoOps timeline/step adapters,
     question placement and historical final-message compatibility only.
- components/chat/message/parts/{ProgressiveGroup,ToolPart,toolPresentation}.tsx
- components/chat/message/toolRenderers.tsx; lib/toolHelpers.ts
  -> tool-parts.jsx. Authorized document names/previews replace local editor paths.
- components/chat/message/parts/{JsonSummaryView,JsonTreeViewer,BlockLine,MinDurationShineText}.tsx
- components/chat/message/parts/jsonTreeUtils.ts
  -> vendor/openchamber/tool-parts/. Original renderers/utilities with import,
     icon/theme and shadcn control adapters; virtual list dependency retained.
- components/chat/message/parts/ReasoningPart.tsx (ReasoningTimelineBlock)
- components/ui/busy-dots.tsx; hooks/{useDurationTicker,clockPausedContext}.ts
- components/chat/lib/streamTextCommit.ts; lib/invisibleText.ts
  -> vendor/openchamber/reasoning/. Original block state, animation, shared clock
     and stream commit algorithms. Runtime adapters supply local translations,
     icons, existing incremental Markdown and native nested scroll container.

- components/chat/message/parts/WorkingPlaceholder.tsx; hooks/useAssistantStatus.ts
  -> work-status.jsx. 1200ms display queue and generic-churn filtering retained;
     local runner phases replace OpenCode state, no silence-time inference.

Hermes WebUI
https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui
Commit: 3aa21f63387939dcff37baa141ad59a0e1e1147f
Source: static/messages.js (_anchorProseIncrementalNode, _smdWrite, _smdEndParser, _safeSmdRenderer)
Adapted in: web/src/agent-demo/streaming-markdown.js and Content.jsx
Changes: React-owned container and code toolbar portals; persistent parser per content identity; only appended suffix parsed; inline http/https URL validation; no word fade or fake typing.

Additional Hermes sources (same commit and MIT license):
- static/messages.js respondClarify / _stashClarifyDraft -> conversation-controls.jsx:
  user/conversation/question-scoped draft preservation through failed and late receipts.
- static/sessions.js _loadOlderMessages -> use-history-window.js:
  older-history reveal and reader anchoring; server still sends full snapshots.
- static/ui.js submitEdit / regenerateResponse; static/messages.js startRegeneration
  -> agent-demo/server.mjs: edited prompt/retry lifecycle adapted to AutoOps permissions
  and immutable original history; no Hermes runtime or mutable history truncation copied.
- api/upload.py (_attachment_root / _session_attachment_dir / handle_upload)
  and api/streaming.py (_build_native_multimodal_message)
  -> agent-demo/server.mjs and attachments.mjs: session-stable file references
  and explicit readable content are adapted to authorized file IDs and cached
  text sidecars. Historical file bodies are read on demand through a fixed,
  authenticated endpoint. Hermes filesystem paths and Python runtime are not
  copied into the Node service. PDF parsing is delegated to PDF.js, not Hermes.

Mozilla PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.4.299
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.4.299
License: Apache-2.0

Unmodified npm dependency used by agent-demo/attachment-pdf-worker.mjs.
The local adapter follows the official Node getinfo.mjs API flow:
getDocument -> getPage -> getTextContent. It adds a terminating worker boundary,
byte/page/text/time limits, package-local resource loading, page provenance,
and explicit missing-text/password/invalid-document capability results.
No PDF parser, PDF JavaScript execution, network retrieval, or OCR is added.
The dependency is server-side; this attribution file does not imply that its
parser is bundled into the browser. Deployment must preserve the installed
package's LICENSE and required resources; platform dependencies are installed
for the target operating system.
